title: Schema-derived processing inventory
objective: Every persisted data element in Unbound carries data category, purpose and classification metadata in its Strata schema definition; a build gate fails when a column lacks it, and the record of processing is generated from the deployed schema.
residual_risks: Data outside the schema (object storage, logs, model provider caches, spreadsheets) is not covered by a schema gate and needs a separate inventory.
notes: Strata is a pilot declarative PostgreSQL schema tool (strata@c6a384ec); per-column metadata support has not been verified.

title: Privacy program charter and periodic review
objective: A written privacy program with a named owner, annual and event-triggered review, and leadership reporting.

title: Purpose-bound internal access
objective: Echelon-internal principals (staff, support, AI agents) can read tenant data only through declared purposes enforced by the authorization layer; each access records purpose, actor and authority, and negative tests prove undeclared access is denied.
residual_risks: Database superuser and break-glass access sit below the authorization layer and need separate monitoring.

title: Customer breach notification clock
objective: A security incident affecting customer information opens a tracked case that starts a per-customer notification clock (72 hours or the contract term, whichever is shorter), with automated escalation before expiry and a recorded notification receipt.
owner: Security incident lead (proposed role; not appointed)
residual_risks: The clock starts at awareness; detection gaps delay awareness and are not addressed by this control.

title: Safeguards Rule element baseline
objective: Echelon's information security program is mapped element by element to 16 CFR 314.4 regardless of formal applicability, with a qualified individual designated and an annual written report.

title: Machine-readable subprocessor register with change notice
objective: A versioned subprocessor register lists each subprocessor, data categories, location and purpose; adding a subprocessor requires a register change that triggers customer notice and a waiting period before data flows, enforced by egress allowlists keyed to the register.
implementing_systems: Unbound configuration and egress policy (not built)
residual_risks: Subprocessors' own fourth parties are visible only through their disclosures.

title: Segregated identity vault with per-person keys
objective: Direct identifiers are stored only in an encrypted identity vault keyed per person; authoritative events carry pseudonymous references; erasure destroys the person's key and records the act.
residual_risks: Scope of elimination is limited to structured identifiers in authoritative events; free text, documents, backups and exports are outside scope.
notes: L1 applies only within the defined scope of structured event payloads.

title: Payload PII gate
objective: A build and runtime gate rejects authoritative event schemas and payloads that contain fields tagged as direct identifiers, and scans free-text fields for identifier patterns.
residual_risks: Pattern scanning of free text has false negatives.

title: Region-restricted deployment policy
objective: Declarative infrastructure templates and deploy-time policy reject any data-bearing resource, backup target or replication destination outside approved US regions; subprocessor endpoints are allowlisted by region.
implementing_systems: Unbound infrastructure templates (not built; provider not selected)
residual_risks: Provider-internal support access and provider-managed replication are outside Echelon's policy and rely on provider commitments.

title: PIA-linked release gate
objective: Changes touching schema elements tagged personal, external API definitions or agent permission manifests cannot merge without a linked, approved PIA record.
residual_risks: Quality of the assessment is not ensured by its existence.

title: No production data outside production
objective: Non-production environments and AI agent workspaces have no network path or credentials to production data stores; test data is synthetic, generated from schema definitions.
residual_risks: Production incident debugging may require controlled access, which must be break-glass and logged.

title: No third-party script origins
objective: Content Security Policy permits only first-party script origins on all portals; a CI test fails when a page references an external script, pixel or frame, and production CSP violation reports alert.
residual_risks: Browser extensions on the donor's device are outside the platform's control.

title: Minimum-data minor records without login
objective: Person records flagged as minors hold only name and relationship, are visible only to the sponsor and advising donor, and cannot be bound to a login credential until a verified majority date.
residual_risks: Age depends on information supplied by the donor.

title: Single model gateway with tenant AI switch
objective: All model calls go through one gateway that tags tenant and purpose, checks the tenant's AI permission, enforces a provider allowlist and logs the call; direct provider credentials are not available to application code.
residual_risks: Provider-side training and retention rely on contract.

title: No standing agent access to production data
objective: Engineering and operations AI agents run without production data credentials; any access is granted per task through break-glass with tenant scope, expiry, human approval and full logging.

title: Aggregate release rules
objective: Aggregate outputs are produced only by a reporting service that enforces minimum cohort size, suppression and rare-combination removal, with release records; no ad hoc queries across tenants.
